purpose: First optimization candidate after the bar-delta fallback diagnostic produced trades. This preset keeps the fallback but tightens filters to reduce overtrading and make results more suitable for controlled optimization.

expected_effect.quality_goal: keep positive return while improving risk discipline and reducing noise trades

notes: The previous diagnostic forced fallback with FallbackBelowTickDelta=999; this candidate only falls back when tick delta is near zero.
This is not a final live-money preset. It is the first guarded candidate to see whether the newly fixed entry engine can remain profitable after stricter filters.
If trades drop to zero again, increase FallbackBelowTickDelta to 10 or disable one filter at a time instead of reverting to the fully loose diagnostic.
